title: Late-Notice Make-Good on Small Business Electricity Supply Renewals After Rollover
content:
**Make-good clause.** For a Small Business Electricity Supply agreement renewed inside the grace period after rollover: when the initial renewal notice for the expired term is missing or was issued outside the window of 90 to 60 days before the expired contract end date, or the final options notice is missing or was issued fewer than 30 days before it, the grace-period renewal rate starts from the lower of the final options notice's renewal rate and the expiring term's rate that the agreement still carries as its held rate; when both notices were issued inside their windows and the business declined automatic renewal no more than 7 days after the final options notice's date, a prompt opt-out now reversed, it starts from the final options notice's renewal rate plus a 0.15-cent re-quote adder; in every other case, such as a decline made later in the opt-out window or an expiry while a cancellation was pending, it starts from the final options notice's renewal rate.

## Records read

- The expired contract end date: the date the final options notice refers to.
- The initial renewal notice and the final options notice on the agreement, the latest of each type by notice date.
- The held rate: the contract rate the agreement still carries after rollover.
- The renewal election and its date on the agreement record, where the business declined.

The 90, 60 and 30 days are counted in calendar days back from the expired contract end date; they are the notice points of every Small Business Electricity Supply plan.

## Starting rate

| Notices | Decline on record | Starting rate |
|---|---|---|
| initial notice missing or outside 90 to 60 days, or final options notice missing or fewer than 30 days before the expired end | any | the lower of the final options notice's renewal rate and the held rate |
| both inside their windows | declined no more than 7 days after the final options notice's date | the final options notice's renewal rate plus 0.15 cents |
| both inside their windows | declined later, or no decline (for example an expiry while a cancellation was pending) | the final options notice's renewal rate |

## Hypothetical cases (expired contract end 31 December, final options notice of 25 November at 9.20 cents, held rate 8.90 cents)

| Initial notice | Decline | Starting rate |
|---|---|---|
| 20 October | 2 December (7 days after) | 9.35 cents |
| 20 October | 3 December (8 days after) | 9.20 cents |
| none on record | any | 8.90 cents (the lower) |
